passage:
A science video showed a battery system that stored heat in sand. Students were surprised because they thought batteries always looked like boxes filled with chemicals.
Their teacher explained that energy can be stored in different ways: electricity, heat, water height, and more. The important question is not whether an idea looks like a normal battery, but whether it stores energy safely and usefully.
Students then designed posters about unusual ways to store energy.
The sand battery made them rethink a common word. Science often grows when people stop asking, "Does this look familiar?" and start asking, "What problem does this solve?"

questions.stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “A science video showed a battery system that stored heat in sand.”?

本文沒有陳述「The Bottle Map」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Battery Recycling Box」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Wrong Picture」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
